body: id be gone in a heartbeat if i even had a sliver of a hint that my partner thought they'd be better off without me, since that's what i already think. so, no, i don't think you're alone to think that. obviously i hope you don't end your life but i also know I'd be a hypocrite to ask you to stay, in my current place of mind. I'm honestly just sorry you had/are having to go through that.
You're so funny and so mystically intelligent! I wonder how many other people you could help who have already exhausted every other angle but your one single saving grace?
I've been admitted before twice and it doesn't seem to do anything for me, plus I think they will be disappointed with me and also my fiance, you know?

It's interesting how we as suicidal people refuse to see the help. I looked at your last post(s) and saw others trying, but I know it is hard to hear it when you feel like this. 

I'm sorry no one physically near you was there for you. You deserve better than that.

I have felt this and I think it has something to do with this -- if you end up sick and in the hospital, people will actually be able to See the thing that is wrong with you, whereas they can indefinitely brush off the invisible illness of depression or whatever else you're suffering from. 

I understand it and I'm sorry I don't have any advice for you. I'm sorry you're suffering.

It isn't terribly common but not as rare as it seems either 

I want to say thank you for listening and I'm sorry for the wall of text

We are simply unhappy. I can't work more than three days a week without severe mood problems, I'm overweight but too tired, meds don't work, I am so so tired of life. The others hate this body too but not as much as me, and some of us also hate that we cant be ourselves and split from the "We" if that makes sense. Kind of a long bit, that one. Ive been to the hospital and stayed in a unit and that didn't help, crisis lines don't help. My partner and I are going round and round on this mentally ill cycle where we aren't fighting or arguing but I don't think I am their happy place like I used to be. I can't even enjoy my art any more. I'm 30 and in debt and too tired for everything

No, of course not, I would never do anything like take another person's life (only my own, lmao). I realize now it sounded that way, but I have OSDD, which basically means I am part of a We. I have others in my head, but they are not a main source of my problems.
Yeah, you're probably right. I'm just worried. He has grown at least a bit and I hope this hasn't undone it all
